rundown: Red Raiders beat Horned Frogs 48-27 at Galaxy Stadium in Lubbock, TX. Red Raiders led 27-10 at the half and never looked back. The 2nd quarter decided it: Red Raiders won it 27-0.

Scoring: Horned Frogs 3 touchdowns and 2 field goals; Red Raiders 6 touchdowns and 2 field goals. The last score: A. Schobel pass to J. Hayes for 11 yds, for a TD (K. Lemmermann KICK) (4th quarter, 1:07).

Leading the way — Horned Frogs: Adam Schobel 24/37, 218 yds, 3 TD; Major Everhart 14 car, 138 yds; Jacobe Hayes 4 rec, 54 yds, 1 TD. Red Raiders: Thomas Castellanos 20/25, 374 yds, 3 TD; Cameron Dickey 4 car, 41 yds, 1 TD; Malcolm Simmons 4 rec, 110 yds, 1 TD.
Where Red Raiders won it: they won the turnover battle (1 to 2).
Against the closing line (DraftKings): Red Raiders closed as 13.5-point favorites and covered by 7.5; the total closed at 46.5 and they combined for 75, over by 28.5.

review.title: The algo's call
review.body:
Logged before the start, last snapshot Nov 26, 7:59 PM ET. It had Horned Frogs 25% and Red Raiders 75%, projecting Horned Frogs 20.8 – Red Raiders 31.1 (51.9 total, Red Raiders by 10.3).

Final: Horned Frogs 27 – Red Raiders 48. Right winner: it had Red Raiders at 75%.

review.title: How the ratings held up
review.body:
Horned Frogs came in with a 7% above average attack and a 15% stingier than average defense (5-6, 22.8 scored and 17.3 allowed a game over 11 games), worth about 192 and 201 games of evidence. Projected to score 20.8, they scored 27 (+6.2 points, 30% over); projected to allow 31.1, they allowed 48 (+16.9 points, 54% over).

Red Raiders came in with a 31% above average attack and a 25% stingier than average defense (10-1, 37.3 scored and 23.1 allowed a game over 11 games), worth about 197 and 204 games of evidence. Projected to score 31.1, they scored 48 (+16.9 points, 54% over); projected to allow 20.8, they allowed 27 (+6.2 points, 30% over).

The bigger miss was Red Raiders' scoring (+16.9 points against projection); both sides outscored their projections, so the game ran hotter than either team's numbers said.

review.title: Where the result sat in the simulations
review.body:
Total: 75 against 51.9 projected (+23.1), about the 93rd percentile of the simulated totals (a typical game swings ±15.5).

Margin: Red Raiders by 21 against Red Raiders by 10.3 projected, about the 76th percentile of the simulated margins (typical swing ±15.3).

An unusual result, but one the simulations saw regularly (roughly one game in six to one in twenty).

review.title: Situational factors, checked
review.body: Market (Line movement signal): Red Raiders ×1.00, Horned Frogs ×1.02. It favored Horned Frogs, who did not beat their projection by more than the other side did.

review.title: Against the market
review.body:
TTU ML (-575) at -575: the algo gave it 81% vs 82% fair (-0.5 pts) — won (+0.2u); lost to the close (closing fair chance 82%). TCU ML (+425) at +425: the algo gave it 19% vs 18% fair (+0.5 pts) — lost (-1u); lost to the close (closing fair chance 18%). TTU -13.5 (-115) at -115: the algo gave it 50% vs 51% fair (-0.8 pts) — won (+0.9u); same number as the close. TCU +13.5 (-105) at -105: the algo gave it 50% vs 49% fair (+0.8 pts) — lost (-1u); same number as the close. OVER 47.5 (-102) at -102: the algo gave it 49% vs 48% fair (+1.1 pts) — won (+1u); lost to the closing 46.5 by 1. UNDER 47.5 (-118) at -118: the algo gave it 51% vs 52% fair (-1.1 pts) — lost (-1u); beat the closing 46.5 by 1.

From the algo's snapshot to the close: total 47.5 → 46.5. The total moved away from the algo's number.

No bet: nothing cleared the algo's bar before the game.

review.title: Where the public and the money were
review.body:
Splits (Action Network): spread: 40% of bets on Horned Frogs, 52% of the money — Red Raiders covered; total: 54% of bets on the over, 65% of the money — it went over; moneyline: 3% of bets on Horned Frogs, 10% of the money.

The sharp side by the algo's read was Horned Frogs, who lost and didn't cover.

review.title: What the algo learns
review.body:
This game's own lesson: scoring came in at ×1.356 of the raw projection, and the home side beat its projected margin by +10 points. It counts toward CFB scoring level, home edge and both teams' attack and defense corrections.

Across 203 graded CFB games the algo now scales scoring ×0.940 and gives home teams -0.6 points. Team corrections so far: Horned Frogs attack ×1.014, defense ×1.011 (4 games); Red Raiders attack ×1.040, defense ×1.028 (4 games).

review.title: Bottom line
review.body: Right side, total outside its normal range, margin within its normal range, no bet.
